ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
onnx-asr runs automatic speech recognition with ONNX models, with no
heavyweight ML framework required — only onnxruntime and numpy. It
supports several published ASR model families (including Parakeet,
Whisper, and GigaAM), handles the audio preprocessing itself, and offers
both a Python API and an ``onnx-asr`` command line entry point.

Model weights are downloaded on first use; install ``huggingface_hub`` if
you want to pull models from the Hugging Face Hub (upstream's ``hub``
extra), which is not required for locally supplied model files.
about.summary: Automatic speech recognition in Python using ONNX models

name: onnx-asr
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.12.0"

package:
  name: onnx-asr
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/o/onnx-asr/onnx_asr-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c1fcacddbced392f9f769ed5c6223f4ce739a6e4549346de33b9b520d4ead713

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - onnx-asr = onnx_asr.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling >=1.28.0
    - hatch-vcs >=0.5.0
    - ml_dtypes >=0.5.4
    - numpy >=2.2.6
    - onnxscript >=0.6.2
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.22.4
    - onnxruntime >=1.18.1,!=1.24.1,<1.25
    - typing_extensions >=4.6.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - onnx_asr
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - onnx-asr --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/istupakov/onnx-asr
  repository: https://github.com/istupakov/onnx-asr
  documentation: https://istupakov.github.io/onnx-asr/
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Automatic speech recognition in Python using ONNX models
  description: |
    onnx-asr runs automatic speech recognition with ONNX models, with no
    heavyweight ML framework required — only onnxruntime and numpy. It
    supports several published ASR model families (including Parakeet,
    Whisper, and GigaAM), handles the audio preprocessing itself, and offers
    both a Python API and an ``onnx-asr`` command line entry point.

    Model weights are downloaded on first use; install ``huggingface_hub`` if
    you want to pull models from the Hugging Face Hub (upstream's ``hub``
    extra), which is not required for locally supplied model files.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
